af01_note: AF01 has NO manifest fixtures (WS226 G_AF_MAPPING: af-only, symmetric UNKNOWN for all). The plan below is the smallest runtime implementation that could qualify AF01 per candidate WITHOUT requiring full candidate qualification. WS230 claims no AF01 PASS.

both_providers: 1. Launch provider from pinned source/build identity (AF00 record); capture provenance (repo/commit/tree/build).

2. RSP HELLO_REQUEST (protocol commander-lab.rules-service/1.1.0) -> HELLO_RESPONSE binding provider/Core/adapter/source-build identity + handshake schema hash + capability bound vector + cardinality set + replay contract ids + topology declaration.
3. Verify envelope validates against rules_service_protocol_v1.schema.json; verify handshake payload schema hash matches implementation.
4. Verify capability flags match observed behavior on at least one live game per declared cardinality (no flag may claim more than the bound proven).

5. OPEN_SESSION -> SESSION_OPENED per cardinality 2P/3P/4P/5P (Forge: 2P-4P per current max_players + documented 5P gap); OBSERVE returns actor-scoped views; NEXT_DECISION yields DECISION_FRAME with (session_id, decision_id, state_revision, options_digest); SUBMIT_DECISION of an offered option yields DECISION_ACCEPTED; stale resubmit rejected; CLOSE_SESSION -> SESSION_CLOSED.
forge_specific: HELLO_RESPONSE must carry dual identity (provider SHA + replay-core SHA) + forge-decision-protocol/1.0.0 class namespace + tape producer id forge-semantic-replay/1.0.0; options_digest aliases legalSetDigest; single-flight + SHA-binding declared.
xmage_specific: HELLO_RESPONSE must carry lane declaration (full-game vs B4-D) + xmage-external-decision-protocol-1.0.0 frame namespace + tape producer id for the XMage lane; options_digest computed by facade over sorted option fingerprints; 6P correctly refused.

negatives: see FAIL_CLOSED_NEGATIVE_MATRIX.json (9 mandatory negative classes, each a must-fail-closed case with exact expected typed error).
success_criteria: All positives PASS + all 9 negative classes fail closed with typed errors + capability vector exactly matches observed bounds + evidence sealed with source lock (lab HEAD/TREE + provider SHAs + schema hashes). Then (and only then) AF01 may move UNKNOWN -> PASS for that candidate/topology. No other gate moves on this evidence alone.
